static_traits.name: Lin An然
static_traits.social_status: 有几位可日常交流的朋友，但not yet向他人分享深层not安与Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗/咨询
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logicality, capable of self-reflection; emotional tone tends negative, often uses absolutist and self-labeling language (such as 'I am a terrible shopper'); high cooperation with counseling, can honestly discuss experiences.

basic_info.main_problem: 我有过度网购的习惯，not断照镜子，觉得人们总是在看我。但我常认为自己买的东西都是坏产品，所以觉得自己是个糟糕的购物者，由此产生自卑和Self-doubt。这些感受在网购增多的这几个月里加重，尤其在收到not符合Anticipation的包裹时。每次网购或照镜子都会出现负面想法与自我批评。
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts and self-labels are affecting my self-esteem and causing daily distress, so I seek counseling to relieve their impact.

core_beliefs: 必须每次都做对才算有价值
他人会以苛刻的标准评判我

special_situations.event: 包裹到货后，商品颜色/尺码与Anticipationnot符
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我买的东西not完美，就证明我have not品味、是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Harsh self-criticism, increases intensity of selecting and comparing, frequent returns and claims
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是个糟糕的购物者

special_situations.event: Repeatedly browsing and comparing before ordering, facing a purchase decision
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should make the right choice every single time, otherwise people will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度研究与比较、沉迷浏览、拖延或冲动下单以缓解not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果买错，do not人会觉得我很not品味

special_situations.event: In public or when looking in the mirror, pays attention to appearance and outfit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有外表/搭配完美，才会被接纳、not会被嘲笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁照镜子、Self-monitoring与调整形象，回避与他人分享not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都在看我、在评判我

special_situations.event: Thinks of past satisfactory purchase experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 个do not成功not代表我会做出好选择，大多时候我还是会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极经验的重要性，继续以失败为主导证据

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, seen as someone with taste who makes the right choices
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被他人评判与羞辱，害怕错误暴露without能与一without是处
defense_goal: Avoiding external blame through preemptive self-criticism
以高标准与Self-monitoring维持掌控感与安全感
回避向他人暴露脆弱以降低Being rejected的风险

object_relations.self_representation: 有缺陷、容易出错、需要not断自我修正的自我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask for evidence of 'whether they really are a bad shopper', or when details of purchase failures are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将询问体验为对能力的negate与潜在评判（担心被指责或羞辱）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责且低沉的语气，反复use“It is all my fault/我not行”，最小化外部因素；语速略快，难以停顿思考积极证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic of 'whether others are watching/judging me' comes up, or when personal preferences and choices need to be expressed in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的苛评感受归于他人，体验为“所有人都在挑我的毛病”（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以not确定但Anxiety的语气，多用“他们”“大家”，将紧张归因为外界目光，避免具体化证据。

manifestations: 虽有朋友可谈日常，但not yet分享深层not安和Self-doubt
Often feels watched and judged by others and keeps psychological distance from people
以Self-monitoring与自责替代真实连结
outcomes: Avoids expressing vulnerability; support utilization is limited
Fights isolation through excessive online shopping and mirror-checking, which instead worsens the distress

manifestations: Rigid demand for 'making the right choice every time'
将选择结果的全部责任内化，难以容许not确定性
outcomes: 决策压力与内疚自责加重
以过度研究/冲动下单来暂时缓解Anxiety，形成恶性循环

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Internalizes a rule of 'must choose right every time' in shopping and appearance
Demanding of oneself with 'should/must' to achieve the perfect purchase
Takes others' possible standards as the basis for self-judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequently looks in the mirror, blames oneself, and carefully corrects appearance and choices
In sessions, tends to look for the 'correct answer' and is careful about self-expression
not向朋友分享脆弱以避免可能的评判

target_behavior.function: 短期缓解Anxiety与not确定性、获得期待与控制感、寻求外部认可
target_behavior.consequence: 财务Increased stress，失败感与Self-doubt worsens，形成恶性循环

When the thought of being watched by others arises

target_behavior.function: 暂时降低not确定性与Anxiety，寻求安心与可控感
target_behavior.consequence: 自我关注与紧张感上升，Reinforcement对缺陷的注意，进一步削弱自尊
